activeSortOrder.description: The default weighted order in which columns and their contents are sorted relative to other columns and their contents. Used when the component first loads. Active event columns need to have sort configured in order for this to work.

columns.description: Used only for determining what columns to show on load.

active.description: Active alarm event columns to display on load.

shelved.description: Shelved alarm columns to display on load.

columnsAssociated.description: Columns of associated data and their configurations.

active.description: A list of columns and their configurations used in the retrieval and display of associated alarm data.

field.description: The name of the associated alarm data property.  It must not match any of the common properties listed in the 'columns' property.

dateFormat.description: A date format string to be applied against dates.

dragOrderable.description: Users may drag column headers to reorder columns of the table.

enableDetails.description: Enable active events table details action.

displayPath.description: Filter alarms by alarm display path, falling back to the source path if a custom display path isn't set. Specify multiple paths by separating them with commas. Supports the wildcard ✷.

source.description: Filter alarms by alarm source path. Specify multiple paths by separating them with commas. Supports the wildcard ✷

results.description: Active alarm filtering results configuration and data.

data.description: An array of objects representing the current filtered data. If enabled and active.

enabled.description: Enable filter results to be written back to props.  Warning, doing so may cause performance decline.

states.description: Pre filters for filter active alarm events.

text.description: The active alarm events filter text.

results.description: Shelved alarm filtering results configuration and data.

data.description: An array of objects representing the current filtered data. If enabled and active.

enabled.description: Enable filter results to be written back to props.  Warning, doing so may cause performance decline.

text.description: The filter text for shelved alarms.

activePage.description: Represents the current active page and corresponds to the value of the page jump input field.

hide.description: Visually hides the pager from view.  Useful when pager is manipulated in a controlled fashion via the activePage prop.

initialOption.description: The initial option to use when the table first loads. It must exist as an available option.

options.description: Rows to show per pager option.

shelvedPage.description: Represents the current shelved page and corresponds to the value of the page jump input field.

refreshRate.description: The rate at which the table will poll for updates in milliseconds.

responsive.description: Responsive layout configuration.  Rows are converted to cards. While in responsive layout, disables or removes certain table features that are no longer applicable.

breakpoint.description: Width, in pixels, that triggers change in responsive layout.

rowStyles.description: Styles to apply to rows given their alarm state and designated priority.

selection.description: Currently selected alarms and alarm selection configuration

active.description: Active alarm selection configuration and read-only list of currently selected active alarms

data.description: A read-only list of currently selected active alarms.

shelved.description: Shelved alarm selection configuration and read-only list of currently selected shelved alarms

data.description: A read-only list of currently selected shelved alarms.

shelvedSortOrder.description: The default weighted order in which columns and their contents are sorted relative to other columns and their contents. Used when the component first loads. Shelved event columns need to have sort configured in order for this to work.

shelvingTimes.description: Available alarm shelving times in seconds.

enableActiveTab.description: Enables the visibility of the active events tab.

enableConfiguration.description: Enables the visibility of the configuration toggle.

enableFilter.description: Enables the visibility of the text filter toggle.

enableFilterResults.description: Enables the visibility of the filters results count message.

enablePreFilters.description: Enables the visibility of the pre filter toggle.

enableShelvedTab.description: Enables the visibility of the shelved events tab.

enabled.description: Enables the visibility of the table toolbar.

toggleableFilter.description: If false, the text filter will not require user interaction to open, and instead will remain open.
